title: storage: the chunked-upload init door does not enforce its declared totalSize/chunkSize, and the presigned request schema declares size as any number
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcScm27Q3R5mkYLPWdB

Found by the contract-tier review of PR #27537 (comment 6496658225, a should-fix recommendation), the fix for #27412 and #27413. Same defect class as #27413, in the sibling door that PR did not touch.

Dedupe: queries "chunked upload init totalSize not validated negative InitiateChunkedUploadRequestSchema" (2 hits: #27412, #24648, neither the same) and "GetPresignedUrlRequestSchema size int min 0" (1 hit: #27413, the presigned door itself), open and closed.

## (a) The init door does not enforce its declared request schema

`InitiateChunkedUploadRequestSchema` (`packages/spec/src/api/storage.zod.ts`) declares `totalSize: int().min(1)` and `chunkSize: int().min(5242880)`. `POST /api/v1/storage/upload/chunked` (`packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.ts`) checks `totalSize` only for truthiness and does not parse the body with that schema.

Reproduction (stock showcase, signed in through the form):
1. `POST /api/v1/storage/upload/chunked` with `{"filename":"b.bin","mimeType":"application/octet-stream","totalSize":-5}`. Expected `400` naming `totalSize`; per the review's reading of the code, a session is minted with `total_chunks` of `-0`.
2. Any `PUT .../chunk/0` on that session is then refused, because no index is inside `[0, -0)` after #27537. Before #27537 the chunk was stored and completion answered 409 for good. Either way the session can never complete.
3. `{"totalSize":"100"}` (a numeric string) is stored as sent.

The implementer re-measures before editing.

## (b) Declared and enforced disagree on the presigned `size`

`GetPresignedUrlRequestSchema.size` is a bare `z.number()`, while the presigned door now refuses a negative size (#27537 declares `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` for exactly this). Recommended in the same card: tighten the schema to `.int().min(0)`, and move the door's check to `Number.isInteger`, so declared equals enforced in both directions. A fractional size is still accepted by both today.

## Routing note for triage

Part (b) is a published-schema change in `packages/spec` (spec lane, schema face, regenerated api-surface and JSON-schema artifacts). Part (a) is door enforcement in `service-storage`. Triage decides whether this is one spec-lane card that carries both, or a split.
